landings: July 1969. Armstrong and Aldrin, first humans on the Moon (Mare Tranquillitatis).
November 1969. Conrad and Bean landed beside the Surveyor 3 probe.
February 1971. Shepard and Mitchell explored the Fra Mauro highlands.
July 1971. Scott and Irwin, first Lunar Roving Vehicle, at Hadley Rille.
April 1972. Young and Duke explored the Descartes highlands.
December 1972. Cernan and Schmitt in the Taurus-Littrow valley; last crewed landing.
February 1966. First soft landing and first photos from the lunar surface (USSR).
November 1970. First robotic rover on another world (USSR).
January 1973. Second Soviet rover, in Le Monnier crater.
August 1976. Robotic sample return from Mare Crisium (USSR).
December 2013. Chinese lander and rover in Mare Imbrium.
January 2019. First landing on the far side, in Von Karman crater.
December 2020. Sample return of young basalts near Mons Rumker.
June 2024. First sample return from the far side (Apollo basin).
August 2023. India's lander and rover near the south pole.
January 2024. Japan's precision lander near Shioli crater.
February 2024. First commercial lander, near Malapert A.
March 2025. Commercial lander at Mons Latreille in Mare Crisium.
